Claim 281 (currently amended): A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer; a second adhesive layer; and a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and the first adhesive layer is aligned with the second adhesive layer.

Claim 290 (currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises a metal.

Claim 291 (currently amended): The tool of claim 290, wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure.

Claim 293 (currently amended): The tool of claim 281, further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers.

Claim 294 (currently amended): The tool of claim 293, wherein the weld ring is continuous.
